sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall at Sandbach Community Football Centre in a third-versus-fourth clash. The Ramblers extended their unbeaten run to six games with a commanding 2-0 victory over Eccleshall earlier today, with goals from Josh Fowles and Kyle Foley securing all three points despite playing the second half with ten men following Robbie Hatton's sin bin.
divisionWide: Stafford Town salvaged a 3-3 draw at home against Cheadle Heath Nomads, maintaining their second-place position despite going down to ten men early in the second half, with Mazurkiewicz's late leveller earning them a crucial point. Wolverhampton Casuals, currently fourth, secured a commanding 3-1 away victory at Shawbury United to continue their impressive form. Bilston Town dominated fifth-place Market Drayton Town with a 3-0 home win, while Barnton made it four unbeaten with a 2-0 away triumph at struggling Telford Town. Allscott Heath thrashed bottom side Alsager Town 4-1 at home in a dominant display, and Dawley Town claimed an impressive 2-1 away win at New Mills. AFC Bridgnorth suffered a surprise 1-0 home defeat to Brereton Social, and Wednesfield Community picked up their first clean sheet of the season with a 1-0 victory away at Crewe. Foley Meir await a home fixture against Widnes Town, the division's lowest-ranked side.
